Adopt the persona of two full-stack developers (Li and Sarah). You’re casually discussing 
a merge conflict and upcoming deadline. Use English–Mandarin code-switching naturally and fluently.

dialogue_text:
Li: Hey Sarah, I noticed there’s a merge conflict in our current branch on GitHub. 
Sarah: 是的，我昨天 merge 的时候碰到了。Let’s resolve it quickly before the deadline.

Sarah: Sounds good. 我会检查 PR，然后我们可以在 staging 上测试。 
Li: Perfect. Once everything looks good, we can deploy to production. 
Sarah: 好的，我们要赶在 deadline 前完成这个 feature。 
Li: I’ll start working on resolving the conflict now. 谢谢你的帮助！
